related.title: etcd 3.6：快照還原、revision跳躍與監看快取重建
related.titleEn: etcd 3.6: restored snapshots, revision jumps and watch-cache rebuilding
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付seat-model.json、request-costs.csv、admission-trace.csv與model-limitations.md，明示未模擬shuffle sharding及動態借用。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver seat-model.json, request-costs.csv, admission-trace.csv and model-limitations.md. Explicitly state that shuffle sharding and dynamic borrowing are outside the local model so future comparisons remain honest.
related.difference: 記錄快照revision、客戶端最高已見revision及規劃跳躍量；判斷新revision是否越過已知觀測，並規劃可驗證的快取重新列舉。
related.differenceEn: Record snapshot revision, highest client-observed revision and the proposed bump. Determine whether the restored revision exceeds known observations, then specify a verifiable cache relist rather than assuming continuity.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: APF以流程及優先等級管理API併發與公平性；本例固定無借用、總60座位、權重2比1，僅用比例計算名義分配。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 等級A權重2分40座位，B權重1分20；A每請求占4座位，B每請求占1，所有工作期間相同且無其他限制。 A同時可放40/4=10請求，B可放20/1=20；A座位較多仍可同時服務較少請求。

etcd 3.6復原文件討論revision bump與標記壓縮，供監看用戶重新同步；本課只算數值與客戶端狀態，不執行任何真實叢集還原。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 快照revision為1000，已知客戶端最高看到1800；計畫增加1000，新revision2000，預留相對已知最高值200。 新值1000+1000=2000；相對觀測邊界2000−1800=200。此餘裕不是對未知客戶端或未來寫入的保證。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: APF manages API concurrency through flows and priority levels. The fixture fixes sixty seats, disables borrowing and assumes a two-to-one share ratio solely to calculate an illustrative nominal allocation. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Level A receives forty seats from weight two, while B receives twenty from weight one. Each A request consumes four seats and each B request one; durations are equal with no additional constraints. A can admit 40/4=10 simultaneous requests, whereas B can admit 20/1=20. More seats therefore need not mean a larger count of concurrent requests when costs differ.

etcd 3.6 recovery documentation discusses revision bumps and marking compaction so watch clients can resynchronize. The exercise computes values and client state only; it performs no restore against a real cluster. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. The snapshot revision is 1000 and the highest known client observation 1800. A planned bump of 1000 yields revision 2000, leaving a margin of 200 above that known observation. The resulting revision is 1000+1000=2000, with margin 2000−1800=200. That margin is not a guarantee for unknown clients or future writes beyond the observed boundary.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Google SRE：共同相依與最小失效割集
related.titleEn: Google SRE: shared dependencies and minimal failure cut sets
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付seat-model.json、request-costs.csv、admission-trace.csv與model-limitations.md，明示未模擬shuffle sharding及動態借用。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver seat-model.json, request-costs.csv, admission-trace.csv and model-limitations.md. Explicitly state that shuffle sharding and dynamic borrowing are outside the local model so future comparisons remain honest.
related.difference: 將服務條件寫為D AND (Z1 OR Z2)，列出使服務失效的最小元件集合，並逐一測試單元件故障。
related.differenceEn: Express service availability as D AND (Z1 OR Z2), enumerate minimal component sets that make it false, and test every single-component failure using explicit Boolean fixtures.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: APF以流程及優先等級管理API併發與公平性；本例固定無借用、總60座位、權重2比1，僅用比例計算名義分配。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 等級A權重2分40座位，B權重1分20；A每請求占4座位，B每請求占1，所有工作期間相同且無其他限制。 A同時可放40/4=10請求，B可放20/1=20；A座位較多仍可同時服務較少請求。

SRE討論共同相依與連鎖失效；本課只做邏輯失效枚舉，不假設故障互相獨立，也不把情境通過比例當成實際SLA。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 D代表共用解析、Z1與Z2代表兩區；三個單點故障情境分別只關閉D、Z1、Z2，其餘皆正常。 失D即失效，單失Z1或Z2仍可用，通過2/3=66.666667%；最小割集為{D}與{Z1,Z2}。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: APF manages API concurrency through flows and priority levels. The fixture fixes sixty seats, disables borrowing and assumes a two-to-one share ratio solely to calculate an illustrative nominal allocation. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Level A receives forty seats from weight two, while B receives twenty from weight one. Each A request consumes four seats and each B request one; durations are equal with no additional constraints. A can admit 40/4=10 simultaneous requests, whereas B can admit 20/1=20. More seats therefore need not mean a larger count of concurrent requests when costs differ.

SRE discusses shared dependencies and cascading failure. This exercise enumerates logical failure scenarios without assuming independent probabilities or interpreting the fraction of passing scenarios as a real service-level guarantee. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. D is the shared resolver and Z1/Z2 are regions. Three single-failure scenarios independently disable D, Z1 or Z2 while all other components remain available. D failure disables the service, while either individual region failure is tolerated, passing 2/3=66.666667%. Minimal cut sets are {D} and {Z1,Z2}.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
